strings.zh: 哦,{VAR:0101:0}！{NEWLINE}我不怎么会用电话,{CLEAR}和平时一样说话就行了吧！
strings.en: Oh hey, {VAR:0101:0}!{NEWLINE}Talking on the phone’s a bit odd.{CLEAR}Just talk to me!
This is Kurt!{SCROLL}Oh, {VAR:0101:0}! What can I do for ya?{SCROLL}
strings.notes: US 0643/2 | RV070: meaning: zh: Kurt asks what the player wants

strings.zh: 你给我的柑果{NEWLINE}做成精灵球了！{SCROLL}{VAR:0108:10}{VAR:0133:11}个！{NEWLINE}随时都可以来拿！
strings.en: Hey, I turned all the Apricorns you{NEWLINE}gave me into Poké Balls.{SCROLL}Come pick up the {VAR:0133:11} {VAR:0108:10}(s){NEWLINE}whenever you’ve got time!

strings.zh: 我现在正在做！{NEWLINE}还有一天就好了！
strings.en: I’m makin’ ’em right now! Just one more{NEWLINE}day and they’ll be done!
strings.notes: US 0643/4 | RV070: meaning: zh: working on it, one more day; US you just asked (D-1915)

strings.zh: 你带柑果来{NEWLINE}就能做精灵球了！{CLEAR}随时都能来！
strings.en: If you bring me some Apricorns, I can{NEWLINE}make you some Poké Balls.{CLEAR}Come over whenever you’ve got time!

strings.zh: 喂喂,我代我爷爷接电话！{CLEAR}我把电话交给爷爷！{SCROLL}
strings.en: Hello, I’m picking up for Grandpa!{CLEAR}I’ll put him on!{SCROLL}
